subject: Request: Rate Fidelity Exemption (3yr term with renewal protection)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Request: Rate Fidelity Exemption (3yr term with renewal protection)

Team —

Quick escalation for exec signoff on a non-standard multi-year structure for Cloudizin (prospect -> expansion). Highlights: they want a 3yr term with a hard promise on price fidelity (no uplift >5% year-over-year) and a renewal-protection clause that prevents punitive increases at renewal for usage within +/-10% of baseline. They are also asking for an upfront 25% effective discount off list in exchange for a committed annual minimum.

Why this matters: Cloudizin is targeting a $2.6M committed ARR starting year 1 (ramp schedule in attachment). This deal would materially accelerate our presence in their vertical and unlock a marketplace co-sell. The ask exceeds our standard uplift guardrails and would require a rate-exemption + contract language for renewal protection.

What I need:
- Exec approval to grant a "rate fidelity" exemption for this specific deal (3yr, max 5% uplift per year, renewal protection clause as described).
- Permission to include an auto-rollback to standard terms if usage falls below 70% of committed baseline for any 90d window.
- Confirmation on whether a 25% effective discount is within tolerance for an exception at this ARR level or if Deal Desk should reduce to 20%.

Attachments: Cloudizin_MA-Request-Calc.xlsx (spreadsheet).

Timeline: Cloudizin procurement is pushing for signed SOC/PO before end of month — they need a heads-up by EOD PT today. Can you please reply with a quick "approve / deny / need changes" and any conditional language you require?

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@cloudizin.com>, Cloudizin Procurement <procurement@cloudizin.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rate Fidelity Exemption (3yr term with renewal protection)

Jordan / team —

Adding the deal summary and Cloudizin's procurement note (see Deal_Summary.pdf). Short summary of the commercial motion: Cloudizin is committing to a 3-year reserved capacity plan with staged payments (yearly invoicing). We modeled revenue and downside scenarios in the attached spreadsheet; with the 25% effective discount + the requested fidelity cap, IRR still looks acceptable because of the guaranteed minimums and our expected upsell curve.

Marissa (key points):
- Committed ARR (year 1): $2.6M; Year 2+ expected growth 12–18% if platform usage expands.
- Upside: marketplace listing + customer reference.
- Risk: if they under-utilize, our cost-of-serving could temporarily exceed gross margin thresholds until year 2.

Proposed tweaks before exec signoff:
1) Keep max uplift at 5% as requested but add a floor on minimum annual billing (to preserve economics).
2) Add an auto-rollback clause: if 90-day rolling usage <70% of baseline, revert pricing to standard list for future invoices.
3) Limit the exception to deals >= $2M ARR or partner-sourced co-sell with marketing commitments.

HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CLD-3472

Hannah — procurement asked whether we can sign if we include a one-time reprice review at year 2 tied to measured usage (not a unilateral increase). They accepted the idea in principle.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Rate Fidelity Exemption (3yr term with renewal protection)

Team —

Thanks for the write-up. A few Deal Desk items to close before we escalate to Exec signoff:

1) Legal redline required: we need the renewal-protection language narrowly scoped — no broader than "for renewal periods within first 24 months post-term, price increases limited to X% if usage within Y% of baseline". Please attach a proposed redline (I started one locally and am attaching a working file: proposed_contract_redline.docx).

2) Tweak the uplift cap to 4% (rather than 5%) as a concession in exchange for the 25% effective discount. That helps preserve margin if they ramp fast.

3) Add a clause excluding pass-through of third-party infra costs without prior written consent.

If leadership is comfortable with these constraints I will prepare an approval memo and the final contract package for signature. We should avoid setting a precedent for wholesale fidelity exceptions; this gets logged as a one-off for partner/deal review.

Ben
Sr. Director, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: Rate Fidelity Exemption — conditional signoff

Ben / Marissa / Jordan —

I reviewed the ask and the risk mitigations. I am willing to grant an exception with the following conditions (please ensure they appear verbatim in the contract):

1) Term: 3 years. Maximum uplift: 4% year-over-year (we will accept 4% not 5%).
2) Renewal protection: For the first renewal that occurs within 12 months after the term, price increases are limited to 6% if average usage is within +/-10% of the final 90-day baseline. Any request for >6% requires CFO signoff.
3) Auto-rollback: If 90-day rolling usage falls below 70% of committed baseline, pricing reverts to standard list pricing for subsequent invoices until usage recovers for 180 consecutive days.
4) Eligibility: Exception applies only if committed ARR >= $2M and marketing/co-sell commitments are added (customer reference + 1 case study within 12 months).
5) Exclude pass-through of third-party infra charges without explicit written approval.

Ben — please compile an approval memo (short) and route to Legal to incorporate the redline. Jordan / Marissa — proceed to finalize commercial terms with Cloudizin and surface the final contract before signature. If Cloudizin pushes back on the 4% vs 5% ask them to accept the 4% or move to a 2-year commitment.

This is an exception I will sign off on once the memo + redline are in place.

—Laura
VP, Commercial Strategy & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
